items.title: Taiwan says China's attacks on its energy sector increased tenfold
items.description: The National Security Bureau in Taiwan says that China's attacks on the country's energy sector increased tenfold in 2025 compared to the previous year. [...]

items.title: Microsoft cancels plans to rate limit Exchange Online bulk emails
items.description: Microsoft announced today that it has canceled plans to impose a daily limit of 2,000 external recipients on Exchange Online bulk email senders. [...]

items.title: Scattered Lapsus$ Hunters Snared in Cyber Researcher Honeypot
items.description: Scattered Lapsus$ Hunters, also known as ShinyHunters, were drawn in using a realistic, yet mostly fake, dataset.

items.title: New D-Link flaw in legacy DSL routers actively exploited in attacks
items.description: Threat actors are exploiting a recently discovered command injection vulnerability that affects multiple D-Link DSL gateway routers that went out of support years ago. [...]

items.title: Kimwolf Android botnet abuses residential proxies to infect internal devices
items.description: The Kimwolf botnet, an Android variant of the Aisuru malware, has grown to more than two million hosts, most of them infected by exploiting vulnerabilities in residential proxy networks to target devices on internal networks. [...]
